title: Fiscal year and periods
sub: Closing a period blocks any entry in it; corrections are made with a reversing entry in an open period
start_month_hint: The year is Gregorian by default and renews automatically with the first entry in a new year. Its start month can be changed only before the first posted entry, and the calendar is rebuilt from it.
form_hint: 12 open monthly periods are created from the start date. Close them later from the table.
empty: No fiscal year yet; one is created automatically with the first posted entry.
reopen_placeholder: e.g. Correct an expense entry posted to the wrong account
reopen_hint: The reason is saved on the period with the time and who reopened it. Reopening reverses the year-end closing entry if there is one; it is generated again when the period is closed.
delete_body: "{{name}}" and all its periods will be deleted. Posted entries are not deleted; only the closing lock is removed from them.
